cine.matriochka.world.1: The air is spores: keep the Toxin low.
cine.matriochka.world.10: Every law at once, at doll scale.
cine.matriochka.world.11: Nothing moves here. Do not stay still.
cine.matriochka.world.2: The rock is hot: mind the Heat.
cine.matriochka.world.3: Every way is locked: find the keys.
cine.matriochka.world.4: The wind never rests: crouch when it gusts.
cine.matriochka.world.5: No light lasts: every sound is heard.
cine.matriochka.world.7: The sea presses down: watch your breath.
cine.matriochka.world.8: The days fly by, and the seasons with them.
cine.matriochka.world.9: The ground walks, and carries you.
comfort.matriochka.cinematics.desc: Boss introductions (bars, title card, the camera turning to the boss), world title cards and the phase freeze-frame.
comfort.matriochka.flashes.desc: The white flash of a boss phase break and the red glow before a signature attack. Off, a soft darkening stands in.
comfort.matriochka.hud_corner.desc: The corner of the screen the plaque sits in.
comfort.matriochka.hud_scale.desc: Size of the plaque with the world's rule, the Doll of Life and the souls.
comfort.matriochka.music_danger.desc: Volume of the tense theme that takes over while creatures hunt you.
comfort.matriochka.music_explore.desc: Volume of each world's theme while you explore, as a share of the game's music slider.
comfort.matriochka.music_layers.desc: Volume of the heartbeat that rises when your health or your breath runs low.
comfort.matriochka.music_stings.desc: Volume of the short phrases that mark a place found, a Journal page or a quest done.
comfort.matriochka.particles.desc: Skips two particles out of three inside the worlds and during boss fights.
comfort.matriochka.patterns.desc: The rule's icons above the hunger bar carry stripes past half and crosshatching in danger, so you can read them without the colours.
comfort.matriochka.shake.desc: How much heavy blows, quakes and trembling World Blocks shake the camera. 0% turns it off.
comfort.matriochka.soft_effects.desc: No Nausea and no Darkness pulses: the server skips them for you and a gentle tint shows how long they would have lasted.
comfort.matriochka.subtitles.desc: Names the attack a boss winds up in large letters, with the time left before it lands.
comfort.matriochka.title: Comfort

ending.matriochka.absorb.0: The last shell breaks, and you do not let what is inside get away.
ending.matriochka.absorb.1: You breathe it in. It has no edge, and neither do you, now.
ending.matriochka.absorb.2: The worlds feel you inside them like a new law.
ending.matriochka.absorb.3: The apprentices kneel. The peoples close their doors.
ending.matriochka.absorb.4: You were the Artisan. You are the creature now.
ending.matriochka.absorb.5: Somewhere, a traveller wakes up on the Surface with a Scroll in their hands.
ending.matriochka.absorb.lasting: Lasting: your strikes hit a quarter harder. Your karma can no longer rise.
ending.matriochka.cycle_hint: The Journal can begin a New Cycle.
ending.matriochka.seal.1: You press the ten cores back into their locks, one by one.
ending.matriochka.seal.2: The forest grows over the forge. The doors find their keys. The wind rises again.
ending.matriochka.seal.3: Somewhere very small, the Unfinished curls up and sleeps.
ending.matriochka.seal.4: Peace returns to the worlds. The peoples will never know why.
ending.matriochka.seal.5: You lie down on the Surface, under a sky you no longer trust.
ending.matriochka.seal.6: One day you will wake up with a Scroll in your hands, and you will not remember writing it.
ending.matriochka.seal.lasting: Lasting: two more hearts. The peoples will remember you.
ending.matriochka.tools.0: You set the hammer down. Then the chisel. Then the last doll, still open.
ending.matriochka.tools.1: The Shadow waits for the stroke that will finish it. It never comes.
ending.matriochka.tools.2: It kneels beside you. It has your hands.
ending.matriochka.tools.3: The Unfinished was never a creature from before the worlds.
ending.matriochka.tools.4: It was the part of you that could not stop.
ending.matriochka.tools.5: Above this room, the Surface: one more doll, painted by the same hand.
ending.matriochka.tools.6: You leave the work unfinished. The cycle stops.
ending.matriochka.tools.lasting: Lasting: the Blank Scroll. Nothing is left to finish.
entity.matriochka.ash_titanid.desc: Raises the heat of the area.
entity.matriochka.chitin_guard.desc: Elite. A shield you must break from behind.
entity.matriochka.colossal_jailer.desc: Locks whole sections of the workshop.
entity.matriochka.colossus_prowler.desc: Elite. Hunts by sound in the dark.
entity.matriochka.dungeon_rat.desc: Slips under bars, attacks in swarms.
entity.matriochka.dusk_shade.desc: Appears only when day turns to night.
entity.matriochka.earth_hand.desc: Bursts from the ground and grabs you.
entity.matriochka.glow_jelly.desc: A small jellyfish that lights the deep as it drifts. Harmless.
entity.matriochka.hour_keeper.desc: Elite. Repeats its strikes on a cycle.
entity.matriochka.inverted_strider.desc: Fights upside down, strikes through platforms.
entity.matriochka.island_warden.desc: Guards a crystal and slams the area.
entity.matriochka.lantern_shoal.desc: A school of tiny glowing fish. Harmless, it darts away from swimmers.
entity.matriochka.living_lock.desc: Pretends to be a locked door.
entity.matriochka.mimic.desc: Pretends to be a chest, an ore or a door.
entity.matriochka.rock_salamander.desc: Crosses lava and raises your heat.
entity.matriochka.sky_harpooner.desc: Elite. Drags you toward the void.
entity.matriochka.slag_golem.desc: Elite. Hardens when it cools down.
entity.matriochka.sporeling.desc: Attacks in groups and adds toxin.
entity.matriochka.trench_eel.desc: Elite. Bursts from walls and grabs you.
entity.matriochka.unstable_sphere.desc: Flips gravity around it when it dies.
entity.matriochka.walking_column.desc: Elite, nesting: falls and opens chasms.
entity.matriochka.wind_ray.desc: Glides and pushes you off the islands.
event.matriochka.surge.1.desc: The jungle exhales: toxin rises twice as fast and spore clouds drift by.
event.matriochka.surge.10.desc: The Workshop's seams give way: every zone's rule bites twice as hard.
event.matriochka.surge.2.desc: The veins boil: heat rises twice as fast and the ground spits flame.
event.matriochka.surge.3.desc: Every lock bites: the halls grind, your limbs grow heavy.
event.matriochka.surge.4.desc: Gusts every few seconds and lightning all around.
event.matriochka.surge.5.desc: The Deep drinks every light: noise rises twice as fast, darkness pulses.
event.matriochka.surge.6.desc: Gravity jolts at random: you are thrown up and caught again.
event.matriochka.surge.7.desc: A deep current drags you and drinks your air twice as fast.
event.matriochka.surge.8.desc: Every season at once: hunger, frost and weakness come and go.
event.matriochka.surge.9.desc: The ground never settles: tremors stagger you every few seconds.

item.matriochka.seed_10.desc: Set it down anywhere and open it: you shrink into World 10.
item.matriochka.seed_2.desc: Set it down within 3 blocks of lava, with at least 4 Ashrock around it: a portal of embers opens World 2.
item.matriochka.seed_3.desc: Set it against an iron door and give it a redstone signal (a lever, a button): the key turns and World 3 opens.
item.matriochka.seed_4.desc: Set it on top of a lightning rod under the open sky. A storm tears World 4 open; a Storm Essence fed to it does too.
item.matriochka.seed_5.desc: Light it in complete darkness, with at least 4 Spent Glow within 2 blocks: its black flame opens World 5.
item.matriochka.seed_6.desc: Set them between two glass blocks facing each other, two blocks away on either side: World 6 opens in the reflection.
item.matriochka.seed_7.desc: Drop it into water at least 3 blocks deep: a whirlpool forms and opens World 7.
item.matriochka.seed_8.desc: Plant it on grass or dirt. It opens World 8 at dawn or at dusk.
item.matriochka.seed_9.desc: Drive it into stone or deepslate below y 40: the ground splits and World 9 opens.
item.matriochka.shell_shard.desc: Left by a fallen boss. Every class upgrade needs some.
item.matriochka.soul_shard.desc: Holds 5 souls. Use it to free them (sneak: the whole stack).
item.matriochka.soul_vessel.desc: Holds 20 souls. Use it to free them (sneak: the whole stack).
item.matriochka.spore_bow.desc: Its arrows burst into a cloud of toxic spores where they strike.
item.matriochka.storm_censer.desc: Held at the arena altar, it wakes the Storm King.
item.matriochka.storm_javelin.desc: Use it to throw: lightning falls where it strikes, then it flies back to your hand.
item.matriochka.tide_harpoon.desc: Use it to throw: it drags what it hits back to you, farther under water. Its line brings it home.
item.matriochka.trophy_doll_1.desc: A painted doll of the boss, won in its trial.

item.matriochka.wreath_of_seasons.desc: Held at the arena altar, it wakes the Master of Seasons.
journal.matriochka.karma.dark1: Prices are 10% higher, but the first black market opens to you.
journal.matriochka.karma.dark2: Some villages turn hostile. Pact quests and forbidden loot await.
journal.matriochka.karma.light1: Prices are 10% lower. People trust you.
journal.matriochka.karma.light2: The peoples welcome you. Mutual-help quests open up and the brighter world variants answer you.
journal.matriochka.karma.neutral: Neither saint nor devourer. Every choice still counts.
journal.matriochka.locked_help: Opens at karma +50: the peoples ask for your help.
journal.matriochka.locked_pact: Opens at karma -50: someone in the dark offers a pact.
journal.matriochka.new_cycle.help: A New Cycle closes every world again, stronger. You keep your souls, karma, pages and gear; your group starts over from the Guardian.
journal.matriochka.objective.end: The ten prisons are open. The Unfinished is gone, or is it you?
journal.matriochka.objective.guardian: Follow the sketch: the Guardian's Sanctuary lies a few hundred blocks from where you woke. Use its altar.
journal.matriochka.objective.next: Craft the way into World %s at the Matrix Workbench and perform its rite: its description says where it goes and what it waits for.
journal.matriochka.objective.zero: The Whole Matryoshka is in your hands. Open it: World 0 sleeps inside.
journal.matriochka.page.1.0: The first prison had to be alive. A forest that grows faster than anything can eat it, and air thick enough to choke a hunger. I planted it, then I planted the people who would tend it without ever knowing why.
journal.matriochka.page.1.0.title: Site note: the green prison
journal.matriochka.page.1.1: She grafted roses onto oaks to make me laugh. When I asked one apprentice to stay with the forest forever, she said yes before I finished. The spores took her slowly. She still hums when the cocoons split.
journal.matriochka.page.1.1.title: Portrait: my gardener
journal.matriochka.page.1.2: Rain and water wash the toxin out of you. A filter mask halves what you breathe in, and root broth slows it more. Never fight the Queen in still air: the clouds she sows linger where no wind moves them.
journal.matriochka.page.1.2.title: Observation: breathe
journal.matriochka.page.1.3: There is an eleventh doll, smaller than all the others. To reach it, close the ten hidden dolls one inside the next. The doll of this forest sleeps inside the doll of the Lightless Deep.
journal.matriochka.page.1.3.title: Cipher, first leaf
journal.matriochka.page.1.4: If you are reading this, you came through a block of earth. Nothing here grew by itself: not the trees, not the sky, not the ground under your feet. These worlds were made, by a hand, one by one. Mine.
journal.matriochka.page.1.4.title: To whoever opens this
journal.matriochka.page.10.0: This is where I worked, kept at the size it had for me: you are a crumb on my bench now. Every zone replays one of the nine laws, because the last prison had to hold them all at once.
journal.matriochka.page.10.0.title: Site note: my workshop
journal.matriochka.page.10.1: Before the worlds, there was a hunger with no edge, and it ate everything that was. It wears my ten prisons now like ten dresses. Each shell you break shows the face of a world you already crossed.
journal.matriochka.page.10.1.title: Portrait: the Unfinished
journal.matriochka.page.10.2: Each shell fights with the rules of a former world: bring what each world taught you. Light, air, cold, weight, footing. When the last shell breaks, what is left is very small. Do not look away.
journal.matriochka.page.10.2.title: Observation: every tool
journal.matriochka.page.10.3: Inside the smallest doll is my room, as I left it. When the work refuses to end in there, put down what you hold, kneel, and let it stay unfinished. The doll of the workshop sleeps inside the doll of the Storm Archipelago.
journal.matriochka.page.10.3.title: Cipher, last leaf
journal.matriochka.page.10.4: Every core you took was a lock you opened. You did not climb out of ten worlds: you broke ten prisons, and what they held is awake now. Seal it again, or take its hunger for yourself. Or find the smallest doll.
journal.matriochka.page.10.4.title: You set it free
journal.matriochka.page.2.0: Every prison needs heat to keep its seams shut. I dug a forge so deep that its fire runs through the walls of all the others. The veins you mine are the rivets of the whole work.
journal.matriochka.page.2.0.title: Site note: the forge below
journal.matriochka.page.2.1: He never let me hold the hammer. He said the Artisan should draw and the smith should strike. He took the furnace as his post and his skin turned to ash around a heart that never cools.
journal.matriochka.page.2.1.title: Portrait: my master smith
journal.matriochka.page.2.2: Heat climbs with depth and near lava, and falls when you rise into the open. Cooling water halves it at once. When the Titan's armor melts, his heart is bare: that is the moment, not before.
journal.matriochka.page.2.2.title: Observation: keep cool
journal.matriochka.page.2.3: Hold the smallest doll in your hand and the next one in your other hand, then press them together. The doll of the forge sleeps inside the doll of the Giant Workshop.
journal.matriochka.page.2.3.title: Cipher, second leaf
journal.matriochka.page.2.4: You will have noticed: every world is shut like a box. A forest around something. A forge around something. Each of them locks something away. I will not write its name yet. Names wake things.
journal.matriochka.page.2.4.title: To the traveller, again
journal.matriochka.page.3.0: No sky, no surface, only keys. A prison made of nothing but doors, so that whatever walks it never finds the same corridor twice. The halls move on their own; I built them restless on purpose.
journal.matriochka.page.3.0.title: Site note: the locks
journal.matriochka.page.3.1: My most careful apprentice counted every key twice. I gave him the locks and asked him to guard what slept behind them. Centuries later, he still guards. He no longer remembers what. He only remembers to stay.
journal.matriochka.page.3.1.title: Portrait: the one who guards
journal.matriochka.page.3.2: A sealed door opens once to a dungeon key. A lockpick opens ordinary locks, never the living ones: those bite. When the Jailer turns his arena into a cell, break out before the walls close in.
journal.matriochka.page.3.2.title: Observation: doors and chains
journal.matriochka.page.3.3: A doll that does not belong will rattle and refuse to close. Start again from the smallest. The doll of the locks sleeps inside the doll of the Restless Ground.
journal.matriochka.page.3.3.title: Cipher, third leaf
journal.matriochka.page.3.4: I leave my plans in every cell, folded small. You will find my workshops hidden in the worlds, my tools still on the benches. An old artisan lived here before you. Read his plans. They are meant for you.
journal.matriochka.page.3.4.title: Plans, for you
journal.matriochka.page.4.0: Here I made a wind that never stops, so that nothing could rest, nothing could take root, nothing could gather strength. The islands drift because what I lock cannot stand still without growing.
journal.matriochka.page.4.0.title: Site note: nothing settles
journal.matriochka.page.4.1: He ran between the worlds with my letters before the doors were sealed. When the last door closed, he stayed on the wind, crowned by the storm. He still carries a letter he can no longer deliver.
journal.matriochka.page.4.1.title: Portrait: my messenger
journal.matriochka.page.4.2: When a gust is coming, crouch or put a wall at your back. Lightning gathers where you stand in the open: move when the air crackles. A glider forgives a fall, a grappling hook forgives a mistake.
journal.matriochka.page.4.2.title: Observation: crouch
journal.matriochka.page.4.3: The ten dolls closed together become one, and that one will open onto the eleventh. The doll of the storms sleeps inside the doll of the Pressure Ocean.
journal.matriochka.page.4.3.title: Cipher, fourth leaf
journal.matriochka.page.4.4: Stop here. Please. I tried to stop the work myself and I could not; I broke my tools and made new ones the next morning. If you keep opening these worlds, you finish what I could not bear to finish. Turn back.
journal.matriochka.page.4.4.title: Stop
journal.matriochka.page.5.0: It fed on light. So I made a prison where light does not last: lanterns starve, torches fail, and the only sense left is hearing. The Silent Ones learned to speak with their hands.
journal.matriochka.page.5.0.title: Site note: no light
journal.matriochka.page.5.1: She volunteered to eat every glow there was, so that nothing would be left for the creature. She is still hungry. She will always be hungry. That was the price, and she paid it smiling, in the dark.
journal.matriochka.page.5.1.title: Portrait: the one who swallowed
journal.matriochka.page.5.2: Every step makes noise; sneaking makes almost none. The prowlers hunt by sound, not by sight. A silence balm wipes your noise away. Against the Eater, listen: it charges where you were, not where you are.
journal.matriochka.page.5.2.title: Observation: be quiet
journal.matriochka.page.5.3: Each hidden doll bears notches under its base. Count them: the fewer the notches, the deeper it sleeps. The doll of the dark sleeps inside the doll of the Hastened Seasons.
journal.matriochka.page.5.3.title: Cipher, fifth leaf
journal.matriochka.page.5.4: You feel it too, now. In the dark, between two steps, something that is not a prowler is looking at you. It has been looking since the first world. It is patient. It is what all of this was built around.
journal.matriochka.page.5.4.title: Someone is watching
journal.matriochka.page.6.0: An inverted prison sends every gesture back. Strike, and you are struck. Push, and you are pushed. Whatever tries to break out of it only breaks itself. Up and down are a courtesy here, not a law.
journal.matriochka.page.6.0.title: Site note: the mirror
journal.matriochka.page.6.1: No apprentice guards this world. I put my own reflection here, with my memories, all of them, so that I could forget. If you meet it, it will fight like you, because it is what you were before you forgot.
journal.matriochka.page.6.1.title: Portrait: no apprentice
journal.matriochka.page.6.2: Gravity flips without warning, but the air shivers just before. Gravity boots ignore the flips, a stabilizer cancels one. Your Double copies your weapon and your habits: change both between its phases.
journal.matriochka.page.6.2.title: Observation: which way is down
journal.matriochka.page.6.3: This is the smallest of the ten. Nothing sleeps inside it but what I chose to forget. Hold it first, in your main hand, and bring the doll of the Endless Dungeon to it.
journal.matriochka.page.6.3.title: Cipher, sixth leaf
journal.matriochka.page.6.4: Look at the bosses side by side: the gardener, the smith, the jailer, the messenger, the hungry one, the reflection. One hand made them, one thread binds them. Break one, and all the others feel it.
journal.matriochka.page.6.4.title: They are linked
journal.matriochka.page.7.0: Pressure crushes what tries to grow. I drowned this world under so much water that nothing swells, nothing rises, nothing spreads. The deeper you go, the closer you come to what it presses down on.
journal.matriochka.page.7.0.title: Site note: the weight of the sea
journal.matriochka.page.7.1: He was the best of the Divers, the one who went down to check the seals. One day he did not come back up. The sea kept him and made him long, and heavy, and patient. He still checks the seals.
journal.matriochka.page.7.1.title: Portrait: the diver
journal.matriochka.page.7.2: Oxygen runs out under water and the pressure bites below the surface layers. A diving suit resists it, capsules and apnea kelp buy time. When the Leviathan pulls, swim across the current, never against it.
journal.matriochka.page.7.2.title: Observation: one breath
journal.matriochka.page.7.3: The doll of the sea sleeps inside no other: it holds the nine. Close it last, around all of them, and the whole will be a single doll.
journal.matriochka.page.7.3.title: Cipher, seventh leaf
journal.matriochka.page.7.4: Ten worlds, ten prisons, and one prisoner. The cores you carry are not trophies: they are the keys of its cells. With each one you take, it breathes a little easier. All of this was made to hold a single creature.
journal.matriochka.page.7.4.title: One creature
journal.matriochka.page.8.0: If it cannot be killed, it can be worn down. I made a world where days pass in minutes and seasons in an hour, so that time would grind at it without rest, the way a river grinds a stone.
journal.matriochka.page.8.0.title: Site note: worn by time
journal.matriochka.page.8.1: My eldest apprentice kept the calendar. He watched every season of this world turn, and then every cycle of mine. He has seen me come through here more times than he will say. Ask him. He will not answer.
journal.matriochka.page.8.1.title: Portrait: the one who counts
journal.matriochka.page.8.2: The Time Workshop only accepts recipes at dawn and dusk. Each season changes the creatures and what they drop; a season preserve shields you from the current one. Strike the Master in every season.
journal.matriochka.page.8.2.title: Observation: right on time
journal.matriochka.page.8.3: Do not trust the order of the worlds: I did not make the dolls in the order you open them. The doll of the seasons sleeps inside the doll of the Giant Veins.
journal.matriochka.page.8.3.title: Cipher, eighth leaf
journal.matriochka.page.8.4: The dust in the Library of Ages has footprints in it, older than the Ephemerals can count. Someone has already walked every road you walked, opened every block, beaten every boss. Someone came this way before.
journal.matriochka.page.8.4.title: Footprints
journal.matriochka.page.9.0: The last lock cannot be picked because it never stays in one place. The ground itself moves, closes, swallows what is not anchored. Its heart beats. It is the lock, and the lock is alive.
journal.matriochka.page.9.0.title: Site note: the last lock
journal.matriochka.page.9.1: No apprentice could become a lock, so I gave this one no face. The Heart of the Terrain does not guard the lock: it is the lock's own body. When it stops beating, only one door is left.
journal.matriochka.page.9.1.title: Portrait: the body of the lock
journal.matriochka.page.9.2: Anchors calm the ground around them and a Terrain Anchor stabilizes a whole camp. Grip boots keep you standing on moving rock. Beware chests and ore that breathe: mimics wait for your hand.
journal.matriochka.page.9.2.title: Observation: anchor
journal.matriochka.page.9.3: When the ten are one, open it only once the Unfinished has fallen, or it will stay shut. The doll of the moving ground sleeps inside the doll of the Toxic Jungle.
journal.matriochka.page.9.3.title: Cipher, ninth leaf
journal.matriochka.page.9.4: Put this page next to the Scroll you woke up with. Same hand. Same crossed sevens. Same blot where the pen always slips. The traveller who came before you was you. I am you. I wrote all of this for myself.
journal.matriochka.page.9.4.title: Look at the handwriting
journal.matriochka.pages.coded: Coded. Carry this world's core or defeat its boss to read it.
journal.matriochka.pages.label: World %s, page %s
journal.matriochka.pages.missing: This page is still lost somewhere in World %s.
journal.matriochka.pages.none: No page found yet. They wait in the structures of every world.
message.matriochka.altar.empty: Place an item on the altar.
message.matriochka.altar.no_doll: You do not carry a Doll of Life yet.
message.matriochka.altar.no_rares: A layer also costs %s rare resources of %s.
message.matriochka.altar.refuse: Cores and dolls cannot be purified or devoured.
message.matriochka.altar.soul_item: Use it instead: its souls are freed without moving your karma.
message.matriochka.apprentice.whole: Ten in one. Open it only after she has fallen. His room is inside. Do not finish anything in there, Master.
message.matriochka.black_market: Under the counter, other goods wait for you.
message.matriochka.blank_scroll: The Scroll is blank. You smile.
message.matriochka.border: The edge of your parcel. The doll holds you back.
message.matriochka.boss_already: A boss is already awake here.
message.matriochka.boss_down.0: The Guardian falls. Its core, the Matrix Workbench plans and the first World Soil are yours. Your Scroll becomes the Journal.
message.matriochka.boss_down.1: The Spore Queen withers. A first layer grows on your Doll of Life. The worlds were made.
message.matriochka.boss_down.10: The Unfinished comes apart, shell after shell. Breaking the prisons, you set it free.
message.matriochka.boss_down.2: The Ash Titan cools down. Enchanting and the Nether answer you now. Each world holds something.
message.matriochka.boss_down.3: The Grand Jailer's cell is empty. A refuge doll is yours. An old artisan left plans.
message.matriochka.boss_down.4: The Storm King falls from the sky. The Artisan tried to stop his work.
message.matriochka.boss_down.5: The Light Eater starves. A second layer grows on your doll. Diamonds return. Something is watching you.
message.matriochka.boss_down.6: Your Double shatters. The bosses are linked to one another.
message.matriochka.boss_down.7: The Leviathan sinks. Every prison was made for a single creature.
message.matriochka.boss_down.8: The Master of Seasons stops. A third layer grows on your doll. The End opens. Someone came this way before.
message.matriochka.boss_down.9: The Heart of the Terrain stops beating. You hold the Key of the Last Doll. That traveler was you.
message.matriochka.class.need_shard: This upgrade also needs Shell Shards, left by fallen bosses.
message.matriochka.class.no_class: This item cannot hold a class.
message.matriochka.class.progress: Your progression does not allow a higher level yet.
message.matriochka.class.single: Tools have a single class; there is nothing to reroll.
message.matriochka.cradle_boss: A boss is awake near your cradle: it stays shut.
message.matriochka.cradle_used: The cradle's doll opens. %s charges left.
message.matriochka.cycle.begun: Cycle %s begins. The worlds close again, harder than before.
message.matriochka.cycle.old_block: This World Block belongs to an older cycle. It crumbles into painted dust.
message.matriochka.death_chest: Your belongings wait in a death chest at %s %s %s.
message.matriochka.doll_broke: A layer of your doll breaks. %s left.
message.matriochka.doll_line.1: That doll grew in our forest. The elders say a doll of moving earth sleeps in its belly.
message.matriochka.doll_line.10: The Master carved this one around the doll of the forge. I held the lamp.
message.matriochka.doll_line.2: Knock on it: hollow. My father swore a doll of hurried seasons sleeps inside ours.
message.matriochka.doll_line.3: Our doll is a cell too. The one locked inside is the doll of the upside-down world.
message.matriochka.doll_line.4: The wind brought this one to us. The keepers say the doll of the giant workshop sleeps inside it.
message.matriochka.doll_line.5: (The Silent One signs slowly: in its belly, the doll of the green jungle.)
message.matriochka.doll_line.6: Ours holds nothing. It is the smallest of all. It only holds what someone wanted to forget.
message.matriochka.doll_line.7: The sea's doll holds the doll of the storms, and every other one inside that.
message.matriochka.doll_line.8: Quick, before nightfall: the doll of the dark sleeps inside ours. That is all I know.
message.matriochka.doll_line.9: Ours swallowed the doll of the locks and never gave it back.
message.matriochka.drill.empty: The drill is out of Blazing Rock: it mines one block at a time.
message.matriochka.event.invasion: The creatures of %s gather. They are coming for you.
message.matriochka.event.invasion.warlor: Wave %s of %s: their warlord leads it!
message.matriochka.event.invasion.withdr: The invaders withdraw into the world.
message.matriochka.event.invasion.won: The invasion is broken. Their spoils wait in a chest at %s %s %s.
message.matriochka.event.merchant: Travelling merchant: %s. Rare wares, for a little while.
message.matriochka.gate.enchant: The runes stay silent. Finish World 2 first.
message.matriochka.gate.end: The portal rejects you. The End opens after World 8.
message.matriochka.gate.nether: The portal rejects you. The Nether opens after World 2.
message.matriochka.guardian_done: The Guardian was already defeated. Sneak to wake it anyway.
message.matriochka.hardcore_dead: Hardcore: your death is final. You watch the worlds as a spectator now.
message.matriochka.inverter.done: The pieces trade places in the mirror. Each paid a quarter of its durability.
message.matriochka.inverter.done_lost: The pieces trade places in the mirror, but %s enchantment(s) found no hold and faded.
message.matriochka.inverter.empty: Place two pieces of gear in the sockets.
message.matriochka.inverter.mismatch: Both pieces must be of the same kind: two armor pieces, two weapons or two tools.
message.matriochka.lair.quiet: The lair is quiet. It stirs again in %s min.
message.matriochka.lair.rearmed: Something stirs again in the lair.
message.matriochka.lair.treasure: The seal of the treasure alcove breaks open.
message.matriochka.lair.wake.ash_titan: The great furnace roars back to life: the Ash Titan rises from the embers.
message.matriochka.lair.wake.light_eater: The last glimmer goes out. Something at the bottom of the pit was waiting: the Light Eater wakes.
message.matriochka.lair.wake.pressure_le: The trench groans under the weight of the sea: the Pressure Leviathan uncoils.
message.matriochka.lair.wake.spore_queen: The cocoons split and the hive hums: the Spore Queen awakens.
message.matriochka.lair.wake.terrain_hea: The veins of the cavern start to beat: the Heart of the Terrain awakens.
message.matriochka.lair.wake.your_double: Every mirror cracks at once and one reflection steps out: Your Double.
message.matriochka.layer.broke: A layer of your armor breaks. %s left beneath.
message.matriochka.layer.full: This piece holds no more layers. Its class level or a Guardian class would let it hold more.
message.matriochka.layer.last: The last layer breaks: the armor itself takes the blows now.
message.matriochka.link.boss: Your World Block shakes and cracks: a boss fight rages inside.
message.matriochka.link.calm: Anchors around your World Block hold the ground still for 5 minutes.
message.matriochka.link.cool: Ice around your World Block cools the veins: the heat rises half as fast for 5 minutes.
message.matriochka.link.damp: Water around your World Block soaks the jungle: the toxin rises half as fast for 5 minutes.
message.matriochka.link.dry: The ground around your World Block is dry: the pressure eases for 5 minutes.
message.matriochka.link.lit: Lights around your World Block feed your lantern: 5 more minutes.
message.matriochka.link.quake: Your World Block was moved: the whole world quakes!
message.matriochka.link.storm: A storm rages over your World Block: the gusts grow stronger here.
message.matriochka.link.unlocked: A redstone signal reaches your World Block: sealed doors open by hand for 1 minute.
message.matriochka.maps.clear: Your map can see in the dark again.
message.matriochka.maps.dark: In the Lightless Deep, your map sees no further than you do.
message.matriochka.maquette: On the Titanic Workbench stands a scale model of your own base. Here, it is only a toy.
message.matriochka.mutation.bonus: The mutated boss sheds a Mutated Scale.
message.matriochka.nest.closed: Click. %s dolls now sleep one inside the other.
message.matriochka.nest.hollow: Hollow. A smaller doll fits inside, or it fits inside a bigger one. Hold the next one in your other hand.
message.matriochka.nest.rattle: It rattles and will not close: that doll does not belong around this one.
message.matriochka.nest.sealed: It will not open while the Unfinished still wears its shells.
message.matriochka.nest.whole: The tenth doll closes around the nine. They are one now. Something very small knocks from inside.
message.matriochka.no_beds: Beds do not work inside a world. Use a Soul Cradle.
message.matriochka.no_dimension: This world could not be loaded.
message.matriochka.not_in_world: You are not inside a world.
message.matriochka.not_unlocked: Your group has not defeated the boss of world %s yet.
message.matriochka.not_your_world: This world belongs to another group.
message.matriochka.npc_hostile: They turn away from you. Your karma precedes you.
message.matriochka.offering.accepted: The altar takes your %s. The ritual begins...
message.matriochka.offering.busy: The ritual is already under way.
message.matriochka.offering.needed: The altar stays cold. It wants an offering to wake its boss (%s): %s.
message.matriochka.peddler.cycle: Back already? Last time you swore it was the end, too.
message.matriochka.peddler.dolls: Dolls? I sell them, I never open them. But I know the rule: the smallest in your main hand, the next in the other. A wrong one rattles.
message.matriochka.quest.already: You already did it here. Find another one.
message.matriochka.quest.book: You find one of the library's books.
message.matriochka.quest.found.wreck_cre: Among the wreckage, a crew plate. You bring it up with you.
message.matriochka.quest.too_late: Night is falling. It is too late for today.
message.matriochka.refuge.boss: A boss is awake nearby: the refuge doll will not open.
message.matriochka.refuge.entered: You slip inside the refuge doll.
message.matriochka.refuge.grown: Your refuge has grown: the walls moved back to make room.
message.matriochka.refuge.locked: The doll stays shut. It opens once your group has beaten the Grand Jailer.
message.matriochka.rite.no_room: There is no room for it here.
message.matriochka.rite.place.4: The Storm Rod goes on top of a lightning rod.
message.matriochka.rite.place.7: The Abyssal Pearl must go into the water.
message.matriochka.rite.place.8: The Sapling of the Four Seasons is planted on grass or dirt.
message.matriochka.rite.place.9: The Seismic Stake is driven into stone, below y 40.
message.matriochka.rite.wait.10: The Traveller's Matryoshka is ready. It only waits for you.
message.matriochka.rite.wait.2: The Ember Heart wants lava within 3 blocks and 4 Ashrock around it.
message.matriochka.rite.wait.3: The Jailer's Key wants an iron door beside it and a redstone signal.
message.matriochka.rite.wait.4: The Storm Rod waits for a storm, or a Storm Essence.
message.matriochka.rite.wait.5: The Black Lantern wants complete darkness and 4 Spent Glow around it.
message.matriochka.rite.wait.6: The Twin Mirrors want glass two blocks away on both sides.
message.matriochka.rite.wait.7: The Abyssal Pearl wants water 3 blocks deep.
message.matriochka.rite.wait.8: The Sapling of the Four Seasons opens at dawn or at dusk.
message.matriochka.rite.wait.9: The Seismic Stake must be driven into stone below y 40.
message.matriochka.rule.burnout: A light you brought gutters out. Here only the Solar Lantern and the Deep's own glow last.
message.matriochka.rule.flipped: Up is down here. You fall toward the sky.
message.matriochka.rule.ground_held: Your anchor holds the ground still.
message.matriochka.rule.gust: A gust is coming. Crouch or take shelter.
message.matriochka.rule.halls: The halls are about to move...
message.matriochka.rule.halls_moved: The halls have moved around you.
message.matriochka.rule.pressure: The pressure crushes you. Climb, or dive with a diving suit and a stronger snorkel helmet.
message.matriochka.rule.tremor: The ground is about to move.
message.matriochka.seed_planted.10: The seed is ready. It only waits for you.
message.matriochka.seed_planted.2: The seed wants heat: lava, magma or a campfire.
message.matriochka.seed_planted.3: The seed wants a redstone signal.
message.matriochka.seed_planted.4: The seed wants the open sky.
message.matriochka.seed_planted.8: The seed hatches at dawn or dusk.
message.matriochka.seed_planted.9: The seed wants a redstone signal.
message.matriochka.server_full: The server holds as many worlds as it allows. This opening waits until another group frees its parcel.
message.matriochka.shake.cooldown: The world inside is still settling. Wait a little before shaking it again.
message.matriochka.shake.empty: The block rattles, but nobody of your group is inside.
message.matriochka.shake.help: %s shakes your World Block from outside: the creatures around you stagger.
message.matriochka.shake.helped: You shake the block gently: those inside find their footing, the creatures lose theirs.
message.matriochka.shake.hinder: %s strikes your World Block from outside: the world quakes and the ceiling gives way!
message.matriochka.shake.hindered: You strike the block: the world inside quakes.
message.matriochka.shake.not_yours: This World Block belongs to another group.
message.matriochka.shell: Shell %s breaks: it wears the face of %s.
message.matriochka.snorkel.empty: Your helmet's tank is empty. Hold your breath and find air.
message.matriochka.snorkel.full: Your helmet's tank is already full.
message.matriochka.snorkel.low: Your helmet's tank is running low.
message.matriochka.snorkel.none: You carry no snorkel helmet to refill.
message.matriochka.snorkel.refilled: The press fills your helmet's tank.
message.matriochka.station.auto_on: The station will keep making %s from its hoppers.
message.matriochka.station.condition.aby: The press must be deep under water.
message.matriochka.station.condition.ash: The foundry needs 1 to 3 heat sources around it (lava, magma, fire).
message.matriochka.station.condition.dar: The altar only works in complete darkness.
message.matriochka.station.condition.jai: Reproduce the lock pattern with the pins first.
message.matriochka.station.condition.lig: The forge has no charge. Wait for lightning under open sky, or feed it Storm Essence.
message.matriochka.station.condition.tim: The workshop only accepts recipes at dawn and dusk.
message.matriochka.station.ferment: The vat needs one more minute of fermentation.
message.matriochka.station.forge_fed: The essence crackles into the forge. Charge: %s.
message.matriochka.station.locked: Defeat the previous boss to unlock this recipe.
message.matriochka.station.take_part: Your group beat this world's boss without you. Take part in its next fight to earn this gear.
message.matriochka.station.vat_bonus: The brew had time to ferment: %s more.
message.matriochka.talent.previous: Learn the talent above it first.
message.matriochka.talent.progress: Your group has not gone far enough for this talent.
message.matriochka.talent.reset: Your talents are forgotten. %s souls come back to you.
message.matriochka.talent.table: Talents are learnt at a Class Table.
message.matriochka.trial.already: You are already in a trial.
message.matriochka.trial.begin: %s begins: %s stages. Falling carries you out.
message.matriochka.trial.busy: Every stage is taken. Try again in a moment.
message.matriochka.trial.fallen: You fall, and the doll lets you out of the trial.
message.matriochka.trial.locked: The Trials open once you have seen an ending.
message.matriochka.trial.rank: Your group stands number %s on the board.
message.matriochka.trial.title: New title: %s.
message.matriochka.world_deleted: Hardcore: World %s broke with its block. It is gone for your group; its rite would open a new one.
message.matriochka.world_exists: Your group already has a World Block for world %s: break it first.
message.matriochka.wrong_soil: This Seed needs tilled World Soil %s.
message.matriochka.zero.chamber.0: The first chamber smells of spores, ash and old keys.
message.matriochka.zero.chamber.1: The second chamber is windy, dark and upside down.
message.matriochka.zero.chamber.2: The third chamber is wet, old, and it moves.
message.matriochka.zero.cleared: The sealed gate sinks into the floor.
message.matriochka.zero.diorama: On the bench, a cracked doll holds a tiny meadow, a tiny village, a tiny sanctuary. The Surface. It was one more doll.
message.matriochka.zero.done: The room is quiet. Nothing in it is finished, and nothing needs to be.
message.matriochka.zero.enter: The doll opens, and you are inside the smallest of them all.
message.matriochka.zero.kneel: Empty hands, on your knees at the bench... the Shadow slows.
message.matriochka.zero.obsession: Your hands will not stop. The work feeds on you.
message.matriochka.zero.room: A bed, a bench, a Scroll. A doll your size, empty. You know this room.
message.matriochka.zero.stitch: The Shadow stitches itself back together. "I am never finished. Neither are you."
message.matriochka.zero.wake: Your shadow rises from the bench, a chisel in each hand.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.matriochk: Every block can hold a world. Ten nested worlds, ten bosses, one Artisan.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.matriochka: Every block can hold a world.
mutation.matriochka.echoing.desc: Every big attack is followed by an echo: a second shockwave.
mutation.matriochka.frenzied.desc: Below half health it heals a little, then speeds up and attacks faster.
mutation.matriochka.hollow.desc: Every 20 seconds it calls creatures of its world out of its shell.
mutation.matriochka.radiant.desc: A pulse of light every 15 seconds blinds and slows those near it.
mutation.matriochka.searing.desc: Its blows set you on fire; a ring of flames follows every big attack.
npc.matriochka.anchored.after: The ground has settled. I keep my anchor anyway, out of habit.
npc.matriochka.anchored.before: Hold on to something. The ground walks, and its heart leads it.
npc.matriochka.diver.after: The deep is just deep now. I can dive without counting.
npc.matriochka.diver.before: Watch your breath. The Leviathan waits where the pressure is worst.
npc.matriochka.doll_peddler.0: Dolls inside dolls, traveller. The big one by the altar is only the first.
npc.matriochka.doll_peddler.1: You woke the Guardian and lived. The Seed will want soil, and patience.
npc.matriochka.doll_peddler.2: Halfway down, and still the dolls get smaller. Mind what you bring back up.
npc.matriochka.doll_peddler.3: There is only the Workshop left. Whoever carved all this is waiting there.
npc.matriochka.ephemeral.after: The seasons still turn, but slower. I may even see the spring twice.
npc.matriochka.ephemeral.before: A year passes every few minutes here. The Master keeps the clock.
npc.matriochka.free_miner.after: The forge has gone quiet. Strange, how much I miss the noise.
npc.matriochka.free_miner.before: The Titan still walks the veins. You hear its hammer before you see it.
npc.matriochka.free_reflection.after: Up is up again, for you at least. I am still getting used to it.
npc.matriochka.free_reflection.before: Your double knows every move you know. Try one you do not.
npc.matriochka.gatherer.after: The air is lighter since the Queen fell. The jungle hums a different song.
npc.matriochka.gatherer.before: The Queen's spores are in everything here. Breathe slow, and keep the Toxin down.
npc.matriochka.lighthouse_keeper.after: The storms still come, but they have lost their crown.
npc.matriochka.lighthouse_keeper.before: Keep low when it gusts. The King throws the wind like a spear.
npc.matriochka.old_apprentice.after: The bench is clear at last. The master would have liked to see this.
npc.matriochka.old_apprentice.before: Every law of every world, at doll scale. The Unfinished is still being made.
npc.matriochka.prisoner.after: The locks still turn, but nobody is watching them now.
npc.matriochka.prisoner.before: Every door here has a key, and the Jailer wears them all.
npc.matriochka.silent_one.after: (holds up a hand to the dark, and smiles for the first time)
npc.matriochka.silent_one.before: (points down into the dark, then at your lantern, and shakes their head)
quest.matriochka.all_at_once.desc: Defeat the Unfinished without losing a layer.
quest.matriochka.bare_hands.desc: Kill a Slag Golem without armor.
quest.matriochka.cartographer_road.desc: Clear the routes of 6 wind rays.
quest.matriochka.catch_lightning.desc: Charge an item at the Forge.
quest.matriochka.compress.desc: Press something at the Abyssal Press.
quest.matriochka.double_meaning.desc: Use the Inverter: swap two pieces of gear.
quest.matriochka.drifting_fort.desc: Stabilize 3 walls of the fort: set 3 Anchors inside the Anchored Fort.
quest.matriochka.every_tool.desc: Use a tool from every world: strike, mine or use with gear of each of the ten worlds.
quest.matriochka.fingers_in_the_doll.des: Craft the Matrix Workbench and a Seed.
quest.matriochka.first_flight.desc: Craft a glider and cross three islands (glides of 24 blocks).
quest.matriochka.first_vein.desc: Extract a whole giant ore: mine a Giant Vein.
quest.matriochka.four_seasons.desc: Live through a full cycle: see the four seasons here.
quest.matriochka.ground_plan.desc: Discover 5 zones: 5 different places of the Restless Ground.
quest.matriochka.hard_harvest.desc: Bring 16 spores to the herbalist (any Gatherer).
quest.matriochka.hour_seller.desc: Give an Ephemeral its time back (+5) or buy it (-5).
quest.matriochka.hunger.desc: Absorb 100 souls at the Soul Altar.
quest.matriochka.impossible_stair.desc: Reach the top of the Impossible Stair.
quest.matriochka.last_fire.desc: Relight the village (+5) or steal its flame (-5).
quest.matriochka.last_message.desc: Carry a letter (a Journal Page) from cell to cell: into 3 different places of the dungeon.
quest.matriochka.last_pardon.desc: Spare an apprentice (+10) or take their core (-10).
quest.matriochka.life_in_a_day.desc: Help an Ephemeral before nightfall: bring one 8 Temporal Sand by day.
quest.matriochka.light_for_others.desc: Free 100 souls at the Soul Altar.
quest.matriochka.light_the_lighthouse.de: Rekindle 3 lighthouses: use a Storm Essence inside 3 Storm Lighthouses.
quest.matriochka.looking_down.desc: Find your base, now a mere object, on the Titanic Workbench.
quest.matriochka.lost_reflection.desc: Bring back an NPC's double: defeat a Reflection next to a Free Reflection.
quest.matriochka.many_hands.desc: Trade 10 times with the peoples of the worlds.
quest.matriochka.miners_pay.desc: Bring 8 ash ingots to the foreman (any Free Miner).
quest.matriochka.no_filter.desc: Kill a Chitin Guard without a mask.
quest.matriochka.no_witnesses.desc: Silence 3 innocents, on the Surface or in the worlds.
quest.matriochka.price_of_silence.desc: Buy 3 goods on a black market.
quest.matriochka.read_between_lines.desc: Read the 5 pages of the Scroll.
quest.matriochka.read_the_plan.desc: Complete a labyrinth map: reach the place it points to.
quest.matriochka.silent_station.desc: Repair 3 station cables: use Abyssal Cobalt inside a Pressure Station.
quest.matriochka.the_apprentices.desc: Find 5 old apprentices (talk to 5 different ones).
quest.matriochka.the_archives.desc: Find 5 books of the library: search 5 shelves or lecterns of the Library of Ages.
quest.matriochka.the_clearing.desc: Purify the clearing (+5) or burn it for loot (-5).
quest.matriochka.the_escape.desc: Free the prisoners (+10) or claim the bounty (-10).
quest.matriochka.the_night_light.desc: Escort the keeper: defeat 6 Glow Devourers close to the Silent Ones.
quest.matriochka.the_peddler.desc: Find the Peddler and trade with him.
quest.matriochka.the_signal.desc: Rescue the castaways (+10) or divert their oxygen (-10).
quest.matriochka.the_signs.desc: Learn the signs of 5 different Silent Ones (talk to them).
quest.matriochka.the_strike.desc: Support the miners (+5) or sell their plans (-5).
quest.matriochka.the_surveyor.desc: Measure a living chasm: reach the bottom of a Living Chasm.
quest.matriochka.the_vat.desc: Ferment a first recipe: brew at the Spore Vat once it is ripe.
quest.matriochka.the_vein.desc: Heal the beating vein (+10) or drain it (-10).
quest.matriochka.the_wreck.desc: Return the cargo (+5) or keep it (-5).
quest.matriochka.under_control.desc: Keep the Foundry at the right temperature for 3 smelts.
quest.matriochka.under_pressure.desc: Craft a Salt Snorkel Helmet at the Abyssal Press.
quest.matriochka.warm_hearth.desc: Bring 16 wool threads to the peoples of the worlds, for the cradles of the lost.
quest.matriochka.who_is_real.desc: Free the Reflection (+5) or take its place (-5).
quest.matriochka.wreck_crew.desc: Recover 3 crew plates, one in each of 3 wrecks.
recap.matriochka.line.absorb: You took the Unfinished's hunger for your own. Every world you opened now knows your name.
recap.matriochka.line.seal: The last doll closed over the Unfinished. The worlds sleep, sealed, and its hunger with them.
recap.matriochka.line.tools: You set down the tools. The last Scroll stays blank, and the dolls rest, unpainted.
recap.matriochka.title: End of the cycle
screen.matriochka.info.body: Ten nested worlds, one inside the other. Find the Guardian's Sanctuary, take its core and plant the first Seed. The Artisan's Scroll and its first-steps card guide you through the first half hour; the Journal takes over after.
screen.matriochka.info.title: Matriochka
scroll.matriochka.p0: Look closely at a block of earth. Inside, there may be a forest, a forge, a prison. I built ten of them, one inside the other.
scroll.matriochka.p0.title: Every block can hold a world
scroll.matriochka.p1: Find the Guardian's Sanctuary, wake it at its altar and take its core. With it, the first world can open.
scroll.matriochka.p1.title: Your objective
scroll.matriochka.p2: The first world grows from a Seed planted on World Soil. Each world after it opens its own way: a heart thrown near lava, a key in a door, a rod in a storm. Enter the block, defeat its boss, take its core. Again.
scroll.matriochka.p2.title: The way down
scroll.matriochka.p3: Death sends you back outside. A Doll of Life breaks a layer instead. A Soul Cradle lets you wake inside a world. A death chest keeps what you carried.
scroll.matriochka.p3.title: Surviving
scroll.matriochka.p4: Every item holds a soul. Purify it, or devour it. Every piece of gear gets a class when it is made. I will not tell you more. I wrote this for you.
scroll.matriochka.p4.title: Choices
stall.matriochka.sold_out.long: Sold out: the trader has no more
stall.matriochka.tip.contraband: Black-market goods, sold only to the dark-hearted
stall.matriochka.tip.discount: Your karma lowers the price (it was %s)
stall.matriochka.tip.markup: Your karma raises the price (it was %s)
station.matriochka.auto.cond.ash_foundry: Works only while the heat is in the green.
station.matriochka.auto.cond.jailer_tabl: Makes one batch each time the lock pattern is entered.
station.matriochka.auto.cond.lightning_f: Spends a charge per craft. Storm Essence fed by a hopper charges it.
station.matriochka.auto.cond.spore_vat: Waits until the brew is ripe (1 minute), then brews.
station.matriochka.auto.cond.time_worksh: Works only at dawn and dusk.
station.matriochka.auto.how: Hoppers feed the ingredients from the top and the sides; the result comes out below. A comparator reads how full the station is. Crafting a recipe by hand also picks it.
station.matriochka.class_table.help: Place a weapon, tool or armor piece. Level 2: 10 souls, 3: 30, 4: 90, 5: 270, and 1, 1, 2, 2 Shell Shards. Your progression caps the level. Armor takes Lacquer Layers.
station.matriochka.grid.fill: Pick a drawer, or lay it out
station.matriochka.inverter.help: Two pieces of the same kind trade class, level and enchantments. Each loses a quarter of its durability.
station.matriochka.recharge.have: You carry %s of them and %s souls.
station.matriochka.recharge.tip: Rebuilds one Doll of Life layer for %s souls and %s rare resources of %s, in any mix:
station.matriochka.soul_altar.help: Place an item. Purify it to free its soul and gain karma, or devour it to absorb its soul and lose karma. Both choices are final. A Doll of Life layer costs 50 souls and 4 rare resources of the current world.
talent.matriochka.berserker_bloodied.des: Below half health, deal 10% more damage
talent.matriochka.berserker_finisher.des: Deal 10% more to foes below a quarter of their health
talent.matriochka.berserker_momentum.des: A kill gives Speed for 4 seconds
talent.matriochka.berserker_opener.desc: Your first blow on a creature deals 10% more
talent.matriochka.berserker_red_mist.des: Below half health, deal 12% more damage
talent.matriochka.guardian_mending.desc: Out of combat, regain 1 health every 2 seconds
talent.matriochka.guardian_thornshell.de: Return 20% of the damage you take to the attacker
Haste while you hold a tool
20% chance to mine an ore twice
talent.matriochka.prospector_ore_nose.de: 5% chance to mine an ore twice
talent.matriochka.prospector_rich_vein.d: 10% chance to mine an ore twice
talent.matriochka.prowler_assassin.desc: Blows struck while sneaking deal 20% more
talent.matriochka.prowler_first_cut.desc: Your first blow on a creature deals 10% more
talent.matriochka.prowler_stalker.desc: Blows struck while sneaking deal 10% more
talent.matriochka.prowler_vanish.desc: A kill turns you invisible for 3 seconds
talent.matriochka.reaper_blight.desc: Your blows wither the foe for 2 seconds
talent.matriochka.reaper_bloodletter.des: Heal 4% of the damage you deal
talent.matriochka.reaper_doom.desc: Your blows wither the foe for 4 seconds
25% chance of one more Shell Shard from a boss
talent.matriochka.reaper_thirst.desc: Heal 2% of the damage you deal
talent.matriochka.survivor_deep_breath.d: +1 oxygen bonus: your breath lasts longer
talent.matriochka.survivor_rally.desc: Out of combat, regain 2 health every 2 seconds
talent.matriochka.survivor_second_wind.d: Out of combat, regain 1 health every 2 seconds
talents.matriochka.active_rule: Acts while you wear or hold %s gear
talents.matriochka.help: Pick a doll in the %s tree. Each branch is learnt from the top down, with souls, then Shell Shards. Forget gives back half the souls spent.
talents.matriochka.need_boss: Opens once your group has beaten %s.
talents.matriochka.need_previous: Learn the talent above it first.
talents.matriochka.title: Talents
tooltip.matriochka.drill.fuel: Fuel: %s / %s squares (1 Blazing Rock fills it)
tooltip.matriochka.drill.sneak: Sneak to mine a single block.
tooltip.matriochka.trophy_shoulder: Use it to set it on your shoulder.
trials.matriochka.board.empty: No one has finished it yet.
trials.matriochka.desc.gauntlet: The eleven bosses, from the Guardian to the Unfinished, one after the other on a stage painted for each world.
trials.matriochka.desc.world: Two waves of the creatures of %s, the second led by its elites, then its boss, stronger and mutated. The clock runs from the first wave to the last blow.
trials.matriochka.locked: The Trials open once you have seen an ending.
trials.matriochka.title: Trials
trials.matriochka.titles.none: No title yet. Win a trial, or a quest that gives one.
tutorial.matriochka.defeat.hint: Its strong blows glow first: step aside, then strike.
tutorial.matriochka.done.hint: The Journal shows every next step from here.
tutorial.matriochka.enter.hint: Use the World Block to step inside the Toxic Jungle.
tutorial.matriochka.hatch.hint: Stay close: the Seed grows into a World Block in a few seconds.
tutorial.matriochka.lost: No sanctuary found nearby: explore the Surface.
tutorial.matriochka.plant.hint: Plant it on the tilled soil, with water within four blocks.
tutorial.matriochka.read.hint: Use the Scroll and turn to the page "Your objective".
tutorial.matriochka.sanctuary.hint: Follow the needle to a temple of runed stone.
tutorial.matriochka.seed.hint: At the Workbench: the Guardian's core, 16 iron ingots and 16 oak logs.
tutorial.matriochka.till.hint: Place a World Soil from the Guardian, then use a hoe on it.
tutorial.matriochka.toggle.tip: Show or hide the first-steps card
tutorial.matriochka.wake.hint: Use the altar at the heart of the sanctuary.
tutorial.matriochka.workbench.hint: The Guardian left it with its core. Set it down anywhere.
variant.matriochka.blessed.desc: Karma +100: a kinder rule and richer drops; its boss shines.
variant.matriochka.calm.desc: Fewer and weaker creatures, a gentler rule, plainer loot.
variant.matriochka.cursed.desc: Karma -100: a crushing rule, swarms of strong creatures and the richest drops.
variant.matriochka.plain.desc: The world as the Artisan made it.
variant.matriochka.wild.desc: More and stronger creatures, a harsher rule, richer drops.
